_readme: An example config for this trade. Copy it over engine.config.json and edit. Prices are in cents: 8900 is $89.00. A service with "due": 0 takes no payment and becomes a visit request instead. This file is served to the browser, so put nothing private in it; the inbox that receives bookings is the NOTIFY_TO environment variable, not this file.

business.name: Northline Electric
business.hours: Mon–Fri 7am–6pm · Sat by appointment · Emergencies any hour

copy.headline: Book an electrician.
copy.sub: Tell us what's going on, pick a time, and hold your spot. Two minutes, and nothing is charged until you confirm.
copy.depositNote: The deposit comes off your bill. If we can't make it, you get it back in full.

services.name: Power out in part of the house
services.blurb: Dead outlets, a room with no lights, a breaker that keeps tripping.
services.label: Diagnostic visit
services.note: Covers the visit and finding the fault. Any repair is quoted before we touch it.

services.name: Panel or breaker problems
services.blurb: Buzzing, heat, a panel that's out of room or out of date.
services.label: Panel inspection
services.note: Covers the inspection and a written recommendation. An upgrade is quoted on paper.

services.name: Fixtures, outlets, fans
services.blurb: New lights, extra outlets, a ceiling fan, a dimmer that works.
services.label: Service call, first hour
services.note: Paid in full up front; covers the first hour and the trip. Parts and further time quoted on the day.

services.name: EV charger install
services.blurb: A Level 2 charger on its own circuit, permitted and inspected.
services.label: EV charger install
services.note: A $150 deposit holds the day; the balance is due when it's charging.

services.name: Rewire, addition or new build
services.blurb: The whole house or a new space. An estimate on paper, free.
services.label: Free in-home estimate
services.note: Nothing to pay now. We'll confirm the time by phone.

urgency.label: Today — something's dead or sparking
urgency.note: Same-day and after-hours visits carry a fee, shown before you pay.
